results.title: Bharat Taxi Pune Fares: Check Auto, Hatchback, Sedan and SUV Rates After Launch
results.description: Bharat Taxi has started operations in Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad with fixed fares and no surge pricing during rain or high-demand periods. The driver-owned cab service offers rates from Rs 18/km for autos to INR 32/km for SUVs and follows a zero-commission model. With 35,000 drivers onboarded, the platform aims to compete with Ola, Uber and Rapido.
